name: plugpup-vin
description: Decode any 17-character VIN: year, make, model, trim, engine, body and plant country from the official US NHTSA database, plus safety recalls on record for that model. Catches typos with check-digit validation and explains common mistakes (I, O and Q never appear in VINs).
